findings.title: Call to `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` does not compile
findings.body: `UsernameForm` calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but the method available in its superclass, `UsernamePasswordForm`, requires a `UserModel` argument, and no no-argument overload is defined in the shown class hierarchy. This causes compilation to fail; pass the context user or add the intended overload.

findings.title: Conditional passkey UI is omitted before a user is identified
findings.body: This condition only initializes WebAuthn form data when `context.getUser()` is non-null. On the initial login page the user is normally not identified yet, so the conditional passkey UI is never configured and passwordless/discoverable passkey login cannot start from that page. The previous code initialized WebAuthn data whenever passkeys were enabled, including for an unidentified user.
